mapper.insert: INSERT INTO http_request_logs (client_ip, method, path, query_params, status_code, duration_ms, request_headers, user_id, request_body, response_body, error_message) VALUES (#{clientIp}::inet, #{method}, #{path}, jsonb_build_object('raw', #{queryParams}::text), #{statusCode}, #{durationMs}, jsonb_build_object('User-Agent', #{userAgent}::text, 'Referer', #{referer}::text), #{userId}, #{requestBody}, #{responseBody}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select:
SELECT id, client_ip AS ip_address, method, path, query_params->>'raw' AS query_string, status_code, duration_ms AS cost_ms, request_headers->>'User-Agent' AS user_agent, request_headers->>'Referer' AS referer, user_id, request_body, response_body, error_message, created_at FROM http_request_logs
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_requests, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1) AS avg_cost_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count, COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip) AS unique_ips FROM http_request_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR')
SELECT to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM http_request_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN status_code >= 200 AND status_code < 300 THEN '2xx' WHEN status_code >= 300 AND status_code < 400 THEN '3xx' WHEN status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 THEN '4xx' WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN '5xx' ELSE 'other' END AS status_group, COUNT(*) AS count FROM http_request_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT path, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1) AS avg_ms FROM http_request_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') GROUP BY path ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT text(client_ip) AS ip_address, COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(created_at) AS last_seen FROM http_request_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') GROUP BY text(client_ip) ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN duration_ms < 50 THEN '<50ms' WHEN duration_ms < 200 THEN '50-200ms' WHEN duration_ms < 500 THEN '200-500ms' WHEN duration_ms < 1000 THEN '500ms-1s' ELSE '>1s' END AS bracket, COUNT(*) AS count FROM http_request_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(duration_ms)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_requests, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 200 AND status_code < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_4xx, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_5xx, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1) AS avg_cost_ms, MAX(duration_ms) AS max_cost_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT path) AS unique_paths, MIN(created_at) AS first_seen, MAX(created_at) AS last_seen FROM http_request_logs WHERE client_ip = #{ip}::inet AND created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR')

SELECT CASE WHEN status_code >= 200 AND status_code < 300 THEN '2xx' WHEN status_code >= 300 AND status_code < 400 THEN '3xx' WHEN status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 THEN '4xx' WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN '5xx' ELSE 'other' END AS status_group, COUNT(*) AS count FROM http_request_logs WHERE client_ip = #{ip}::inet AND created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT path, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1) AS avg_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count FROM http_request_logs WHERE client_ip = #{ip}::inet AND created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') GROUP BY path ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT ${timeBucketExpr} AS time_bucket, COUNT(*) AS count FROM http_request_logs WHERE client_ip = #{ip}::inet AND created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
mapper.sql: WHERE client_ip = #{ip}::inet AND created_at >= NOW() - (#{intervalHours} * INTERVAL '1 HOUR') AND method = #{method} AND path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{path}, '%') AND status_code >= 200 AND status_code < 300 AND status_code >= 300 AND status_code < 400 AND status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 AND status_code >= 500
mapper.select:
SELECT id, client_ip AS ip_address, method, path, query_params->>'raw' AS query_string, status_code, duration_ms AS cost_ms, request_headers->>'User-Agent' AS user_agent, request_headers->>'Referer' AS referer, user_id, request_body, response_body, error_message, created_at FROM http_request_logs
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
